v.deps: Child of EP-57118. Relies on the existing Admin Panel > Sessions > Display Filters label and its localised variants, which the platform already respects elsewhere; no Admin Panel changes are in scope. Risk if delayed: clients who renamed Tracks keep seeing an inconsistent 'By Track' label.
v.feature: Session Calendar: Sync "By Track" drawer label with the Admin Display Filter name
v.impact: Attendees: consistent taxonomy and terminology throughout agenda browsing. Organizers: full white-label fidelity — custom filter naming is respected everywhere.
v.rationale: When organizers rename the "Track" taxonomy in admin (to "Stage", "Theme", "Stream" or "Room"), the calendar side drawer previously hardcoded "By Track", causing brand confusion and attendee disorientation.
v.why: For DLG: the calendar drawer hardcodes 'By Track' and ignores the filter name the organiser set, which the rest of the event uses.
